main_text.p: Aptari, Dirigi, Rectum esse. Pihel תְּכֵן Aptare, Dirigere, Appendere, Expendere. Pyhal תְּכֵן Appendi.
תְּכֻנִית f. Idem. תִּכּוּנָה Vide in כון.
תְּלָג Chald. Nix, Dan. 7.9: ex Hebraeo literis שׁ & ת permutatis.
תְּלָה Suspendere. Niphal נִתְלָה Suspendi. Pihel תִּלָּה Suspendere.
תַּלְפִּיּוֹת f. p. Armaria, à Suspensis armis dicta.
תּוֹלְלִים m. p. Contumulatores, id est, Inimici.
תֹּלָם תֹּלָם m. Porca agri: plur. הָלָמִים.
מִתְלַעִּים m. p. Coccinati, Coccino induti.
תְּלָתָה , תְּלָתָה Chald. Tres. תְּלָתִין Triginta.
Dan. 2.39, quod legendum תְּלִיתָאֵי , ex Hebraeo

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek forms are approximated where the scan is blurred; the Hebrew vocalisation in several entries (e.g. תִּלְתַּלִּים, תּוֹלַעַת) is doubtful. Hebrew line 'תִּלְתַּלִּים' and the Chaldee forms in the last lines are partly illegible. The line with 'Dan. 2.39' ends with "Hebraeo" on a continuation line, set right.
